summary: Frontend-only content rewrite verification across EGMG site. Most rewrites are correctly implemented (Home brand cards, Navigation dropdown, Footer, About, Businesses, Contact form with Enquiry Type as FIRST field, Europcar, Truckline, Careers, Goldcar, Chauffeur hero/intro). However, several visible occurrences of the OLD brand names ('Eurogulf Chauffeur' and 'Eurogulf Autocare') still remain in user-facing copy on Chauffeur, Autocare, and Services pages, and in SEO meta description. These must be replaced with 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur' and 'Eurogulf Auto Garage'.

(line 372), (b) section heading 'Benefits of Working with Eurogulf Chauffeur' (line 469). Should be 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur'.

Body copy still says 'Eurogulf Autocare' in 3 visible places (lines 61, 64, 150). Headline says 'Eurogulf Auto Garage' but supporting paragraphs and CTA copy still use old 'Autocare' name — inconsistent with the rename.

Service card uses old 'Eurogulf Chauffeur' label in 2 visible places: heading 'Eurogulf Chauffeur Details' and pill 'Eurogulf Chauffeur · Luxury Coaches' (lines 285, 308). Should be 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur'.
Default site SEO description still lists old brand names: 'Eurogulf Chauffeur' and 'Eurogulf Autocare' in /app/frontend/src/components/SEO.js line 96. Visible to search engines and social previews.

critical_code_review_comments: Brand-rename inconsistency: hero/H1 was updated on Autocare and Chauffeur pages but the body copy paragraphs in the same files were left with the old brand name — this is a copy-paste/partial-edit gap and is the kind of issue best caught with a global grep before merging a rename PR.

ServicesPage was not in the files-of-reference list but still surfaces the old 'Eurogulf Chauffeur' label twice — consider grepping the whole codebase for the old brand strings to ensure no page was missed.
SEO.js default description should be sourced from a single brand-config object to prevent drift between visible copy and meta tags during future renames.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All key rewritten pages render correctly with the new copy. The remaining work is a search-and-replace cleanup of leftover 'Eurogulf Chauffeur' (must be 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur') and 'Eurogulf Autocare' (must be 'Eurogulf Auto Garage') in ChauffeurServicePage.js, AutocarePage.js, ServicesPage.js and SEO.js. After fix, re-run: grep -rn 'Eurogulf Chauffeur\|Eurogulf Autocare' /app/frontend/src/ — should return zero matches except where preceded by 'Premium '.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: visit /chauffeur-service and scroll to the 'Our Drivers Are the Difference' and 'Benefits of Working with...' sections — text reads 'Eurogulf Chauffeur'. Visit /autocare and read the intro paragraphs — text reads 'Eurogulf Autocare' three times. Visit /services and view the Chauffeur card — pill and heading read 'Eurogulf Chauffeur'. Root cause: partial rename — only headings/H1 strings and the navigation/footer constants were updated; in-page body strings were not globally replaced. Mitigation: do a project-wide string replace of 'Eurogulf Chauffeur' → 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur' and 'Eurogulf Autocare' → 'Eurogulf Auto Garage', taking care not to double-prefix already-renamed strings (use a regex like /Eurogulf Chauffeur(?! )/ + verify, or two-step: replace 'Eurogulf Premium Chauffeur' temporarily, do the global swap, then restore).
